claim_detail.basis: Both attempts descended to the exact target grasp-center pose per planner SUCCESS, but the measured final object pose after release deviated far beyond tolerance each time, and the second attempt (a clean re-grasp and re-approach) was worse than the first -- indicating the part is catching/jamming against the fixture or an adjacent part during insertion rather than a one-off execution glitch. Visual inspection (look) did not resolve this at available camera resolution/occlusion.

arguments.reason: u_brown seated successfully (step place_u_brown: success, verified within tolerance). u_orange failed to seat correctly after two attempts, the second worse than the first (117 deg orientation error, 4.5cm position error vs 10deg/2cm tolerances), indicating a jam/catch during insertion that blind retrying was not resolving and was trending toward more disturbance, not less. Stopped before line_green and inverted_u_yellow steps rather than risk further damage.
